source_topic: Offer premium and equity purchase price

follow_up.question: Why is equity purchase price different from enterprise purchase price?
follow_up.reference: Equity purchase price pays for the common-share claim. Enterprise purchase price also reflects the treatment of debt, other non-equity claims and excess cash.

instances.text: You calculate the equity cheque for a takeover proposal. The target has 200 million fully diluted common shares and an unaffected share price of 20 dollars. What is the equity purchase price, in millions of dollars?
